subject: Converting Argo Systems to Azure Marketplace billing — next steps and timelines
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@argo-systems.com>
Cc: procurement@argo-systems.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Converting Argo Systems to Azure Marketplace billing — quick proposal

Hi Maria,

Thanks again for the time last week — we really appreciate Argo Systems' partnership and the expansion you outlined for Q3. Per our conversation, the simplest route to accelerate procurement and enable co-sell incentives with Microsoft is to move your Redwood subscription to Azure Marketplace billing.

Quick summary of what this involves:
- Convert current direct invoice to a Marketplace entitlement tied to your Azure tenant.
- Align SKUs so your purchase orders map to the same units you consume today (we've pre-mapped these in the attached spreadsheet).
- One-time amendment to the current order (we can do a short DocuSign addendum that preserves pricing and term).
- Expected go-live: once DocuSign is executed and Azure procurement confirms entitlement (typically 7–10 business days).

Next steps I suggest:
1) I'll send a short amendment PDF for your legal/procurement to review (attached).
2) Procurement to confirm the billing owner and the Azure tenant ID we should bind the entitlement to.
3) We'll kick off marketplace activation with Azure — I'll loop in our partner ops if you want co-sell enablement during the rollout.

Can you confirm who on your side should receive the DocuSign and whether the Azure tenant ID is the same as last year (tenant-id: 72f9-xxxx)? If procurement wants a quick call, I'm flexible this week.

Thanks — looking forward to making this low-friction.

Best,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood-marketplace-amendment-draft.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)
Attachment: azure-sku-mapping.xlsx (XLSX, 24 KB)

From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@argo-systems.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@argo-systems.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Converting Argo Systems to Azure Marketplace billing — quick proposal

Thanks Karthik — this looks promising.

Quick answers: procurement@argo-systems.com is the right inbox for DocuSign and invoice questions. Our procurement lead is Jorge Ramirez (jorge.ramirez@argo-systems.com) — copying him below. The Azure tenant ID is the same (72f9-xxxx).

We have two things procurement will want to confirm:
- That the marketplace path preserves the current seat-based pricing and that the SKU mapping is 1:1 (so our internal chargebacks remain identical).
- Whether there will be any delay to service continuity (we need zero downtime for the data pipelines).

Can your legal team add a clause that explicitly states no service interruption during the billing cutover? If you can include that in the amendment, procurement should be comfortable reviewing and signing.

If helpful, Jorge and I are available for a 30-min call tomorrow afternoon.

Best,
Maria Lopez
Head of Platform Partnerships
Argo Systems

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Converting Argo Systems to Azure Marketplace billing — quick proposal

Karthik — copying you my suggested edit set for the amendment; keeping it tight per Maria's ask re: no downtime. Legal reviewed and recommended the following short paragraph for the DocuSign addendum: 

"Billing cutover clause: Redwood will coordinate the entitlement activation with the customer's cloud provider and will not make changes to customer-facing service configurations that cause interruption of access. Any backend entitlement binding required for Azure Marketplace enablement will be performed during pre-agreed maintenance windows with written consent from the customer and will aim to be non-disruptive to production traffic."

I've added the above to the attached PDF (redwood-marketplace-amendment-draft.pdf) and updated the SKU mapping sheet to include RBAC mappings for Argo's chargeback owners.

Operational notes:
- Partner ops will require the Azure tenant ID and an SPOC (Jorge).
- We can start the marketplace activation as soon as DocuSign returns executed — Ops ETA 5 business days to provision entitlements.
- If Argo wants co-sell registration, that's a separate intake we'll start during the activation to capture the Microsoft opportunity ID.

I recommend we schedule the 30-min call tomorrow at 3pm PT with Maria and Jorge to walk procurement through the amendment. Karthik — can you confirm?

Thanks,
Lauren
Senior Manager, Partner & Marketplace
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-marketplace-amendment-draft.pdf (updated)
Attachment: azure-sku-mapping.xlsx (updated)
